user.title: Configure Portfolio Architect
user.description: Choose a source adapter and the local Portfolio Architect configuration. CSV remains the default; the REST adapter accepts only a bounded local gateway.

data_description.source_provider: Choose Comdirect CSV, DKB depot CSV, a mapped generic CSV, or the local REST JSON gateway contract.
data_description.config_directory: Relative to /config. It must contain portfolio.yaml, policy.yaml, instruments.yaml, and broker.yaml; exceptions.yaml is optional.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure portfolio source
reconfigure.description: Change the source adapter or its connection details. The complete source is validated before the integration reloads.

data_description.source_provider: Choose Comdirect CSV, DKB depot CSV, a mapped generic CSV, or the local REST JSON gateway contract.
data_description.config_directory: Relative to /config. It must contain portfolio.yaml, policy.yaml, instruments.yaml, and broker.yaml; exceptions.yaml is optional.

csv_source.title: Configure CSV source
csv_source.description: Select the portfolio export file. It is confined to the Home Assistant configuration directory and validated before setup completes.

rest_source.title: Configure local REST gateway
rest_source.description: Connect to a read-only local gateway that publishes the Portfolio Architect JSON contract. Banking credentials stay in the gateway and are never stored in Home Assistant.

data_description.rest_endpoint_url: Verified HTTPS URL without credentials, query, or fragment. The host must resolve exclusively to loopback, link-local, or private addresses. Existing pre-v1.27 HTTP entries are migrated through Supervisor trust discovery.
data_description.rest_api_token: Dedicated low-privilege token used only between Home Assistant and the local gateway. Minimum length: 16 characters.

reauth_confirm.title: Update local gateway token
reauth_confirm.description: The local REST gateway rejected its bearer token. Enter a replacement token; the gateway response is validated before the integration reloads.

data_description.rest_api_token: Dedicated low-privilege token used only between Home Assistant and the local gateway.

generic_format.title: Generic CSV format
generic_format.description: Describe how the CSV is encoded. Automatic detection is recommended first.

data_description.csv_header_row: One-based row number containing unique column names (1–50).
data_description.csv_decimal_format: How decimal and thousands separators should be interpreted.

generic_mapping.title: Map generic CSV columns
generic_mapping.description: Header row {header_row} contains {column_count} columns. Map the required fields and optional metadata. Market values must already be in EUR.

data_description.csv_column_identifier: Use WKN, ISIN, ticker, or another stable identifier. Values must be unique.
data_description.csv_column_currency: Optional. When mapped, every imported row must explicitly contain EUR or €.

hassio_confirm.title: Connect discovered Portfolio Architect Gateway securely
hassio_confirm.description: Home Assistant Supervisor provided verified private-CA trust for {gateway}. Enter the existing Gateway bearer token and Portfolio Architect configuration directory; the HTTPS endpoint is validated before setup completes.

data_description.config_directory: Relative to /config. It must contain the Portfolio Architect policy/configuration files.
data_description.rest_api_token: Dedicated bearer token for this Gateway. TLS trust is supplied separately through Supervisor discovery.

hassio_add_supplemental_confirm.title: Add discovered Portfolio Architect Gateway securely
hassio_add_supplemental_confirm.description: Home Assistant Supervisor discovered {provider} at {gateway} and supplied its private CA. Enter that Gateway’s existing bearer token to validate and add it as an additional portfolio source.

data_description.rest_api_token: Dedicated bearer token for this Gateway. The HTTPS endpoint and private CA are supplied through Supervisor discovery.

error.invalid_path: The configured path is unsafe or points outside the Home Assistant configuration directory.
error.source_unavailable: The configured CSV or required configuration files could not be found.
error.invalid_source: The configured files could not be parsed into a valid Portfolio Architect calculation.
error.invalid_csv_format: The CSV header could not be read with these format settings.
error.invalid_rest_source: The local REST gateway or its JSON response did not satisfy the bounded Portfolio Architect source contract.
error.invalid_auth: The local REST gateway rejected the bearer token.

abort.already_configured: Portfolio Architect is already configured. Use Reconfigure on the existing integration entry to change its source.
abort.reauth_not_supported: Reauthentication is only available for the local REST gateway adapter.
abort.invalid_tls_discovery: Gateway TLS discovery data was invalid and was rejected.
abort.tls_discovery_not_primary: This discovered Gateway cannot create the primary Portfolio Architect entry.
abort.tls_discovery_not_applicable: The discovered Gateway does not match a configured Portfolio Architect REST source.
abort.tls_trust_changed: The Gateway presented a different private CA for an already-secured source. Automatic trust replacement is refused.
abort.tls_already_configured: This Gateway already uses the discovered verified HTTPS trust.
abort.tls_validation_failed: The discovered HTTPS endpoint could not be validated with the supplied private CA and existing bearer token.
abort.tls_migrated: The matching Gateway source was migrated to verified HTTPS successfully.
abort.tls_supplemental_added: The discovered Gateway was validated and added as a verified-HTTPS supplemental source.

plan.title: Configure investment plan
plan.description: Define the budget, cadence, and instruments managed by the current plan. Imported holdings outside this selection remain part of the complete portfolio.

data_description.plan_budget_amount: The amount is either split across all executions in the period or applied to every execution.
data_description.plan_schedule_enabled: Enable this to calculate planned executions, review dates, and schedule-aware freshness.
data_description.selected_instruments: Select between 1 and 32 instruments. Every selected instrument receives a target weight in the next steps.

schedule.title: Configure recurring execution schedule
schedule.description: Configure the recurring execution pattern. The next evaluation is scheduled before a later execution using the review lead time.

data_description.review_lead_days: Number of days before the execution for which the next review is due.
data_description.plan_execution_days: Weekly plans use weekdays; all other plans use days of month from 1 to 28.

plan_review.title: Normalise target weights
plan_review.description: The {instrument_count} target weights currently total {target_total}%. Enable normalisation to scale them proportionally to exactly 100%.

runtime.title: Runtime safeguards
runtime.description: The age threshold is used only when no review schedule is configured. With a schedule, data remains fresh through the planned review date.

data_description.freshness_hours: Allowed data age when no recurring review schedule is configured (1–168 hours).

reset_plan.title: Restore file-based plan
reset_plan.description: Discard the Home Assistant plan override and use the plan defined in portfolio.yaml again. Runtime safeguards are preserved.

sources.title: Portfolio sources
sources.description: Manage supplemental portfolio sources. Every source is normalized before aggregation; provider-specific acquisition stays outside Portfolio Architect.

execution.title: Execution and transaction costs
execution.description: Choose how Portfolio Architect balances regular investing, allocation drift, and execution costs. Existing installations remain on legacy distribution until cost-aware execution is enabled.

data_description.execution_cost_aware_enabled: When disabled, the established monthly distribution algorithm remains unchanged.
data_description.execution_policy: Monthly continuity invests each period; Balanced observes the cost ceiling but eventually executes; Efficiency first waits until the ceiling is met.
data_description.execution_max_cost_ratio_pct: Maximum estimated transaction fees as a percentage of the proposed order value.
data_description.execution_max_deferral_periods: Balanced mode may exceed the cost ceiling after this many accumulated contribution periods.
data_description.execution_max_orders: Limits how many separate fee-bearing orders are proposed for one execution.
data_description.execution_reserve_mode: Gateway authorized cash requires an explicitly selected dedicated Comdirect account. Contribution-only uses only the current plan contribution.
data_description.manual_settlement_fee_eur: Configure the additional fixed settlement charge observed for the selected execution route.

execution_fees.title: Manual-order cost model
execution_fees.description: Configure the estimated fees for manual exchange orders. These values are planning assumptions and do not place an order.

data_description.manual_commission_pct: Percentage of the order value. Enter 0.25 for 0.25%.
data_description.manual_settlement_fee_eur: Additional fixed settlement charge observed for the selected execution route.

dkb_sources.title: DKB CSV sources
dkb_sources.description: Add DKB depot exports to the primary source, one relative CSV path per line. Positions are consolidated by ISIN; depot numbers are ignored.

data_description.supplemental_dkb_csv_paths: Relative to /config. Use one current export per DKB depot. If several dated exports of the same depot are configured, only the newest is counted. Up to 8 paths are supported.

rest_gateways.title: Additional REST Gateways
rest_gateways.description: Add or remove independent local Portfolio Architect Gateways. Each Gateway remains separately authenticated and provider-isolated.

add_rest_gateway.title: Add REST Gateway
add_rest_gateway.description: Connect one additional read-only local Gateway. Its health document must expose a stable provider identity and a validated snapshot before it is saved.

data_description.rest_endpoint_url: Verified HTTPS portfolio endpoint on a loopback, link-local, or private address.
data_description.rest_api_token: Dedicated low-privilege bearer token for this Gateway. It is stored only in the Home Assistant config entry options.

remove_rest_gateway.title: Remove REST Gateway
remove_rest_gateway.description: Stop consuming one additional Gateway. The Gateway App and its private data are not changed.

error.invalid_instrument: The selected instrument is no longer available.
error.invalid_target: Enter a target weight above 0% and at most 100%.
error.invalid_schedule: The recurring schedule is incomplete or invalid.
error.targets_not_100: The target weights must total exactly 100% or be explicitly normalised.
error.invalid_supplemental_source: At least one supplemental DKB CSV is missing, unsafe, or not a supported DKB depot export.
error.too_many_sources: At most 8 supplemental portfolio sources are supported in total.
error.invalid_execution_config: The execution-cost settings are inconsistent or outside the supported range.
error.invalid_auth: The local Gateway rejected its bearer token.
error.invalid_rest_gateway: The additional Gateway is unavailable, duplicates an existing provider/endpoint, or does not expose a valid live schema-6 snapshot.
error.too_many_rest_gateways: At most 4 additional REST Gateways are supported.

abort.plan_source_unavailable: The local portfolio files could not be read for the plan editor.
abort.invalid_plan: The configured plan failed validation and was not saved.
abort.plan_already_uses_yaml: The investment plan already uses portfolio.yaml.
abort.no_rest_gateways: No additional REST Gateways are configured.
abort.rest_gateways_require_rest_primary: Additional REST Gateways require the primary Portfolio Architect source to be a REST Gateway.

gateway_reauthentication_required.title: Portfolio Gateway requires Comdirect reauthentication
gateway_reauthentication_required.description: Open the Portfolio Architect Gateway App Web UI and complete a new PhotoTAN bootstrap. Portfolio Architect keeps the last-known-good snapshot but will stop treating it as actionable when it becomes stale.

gateway_repeated_refresh_failures.title: Portfolio Gateway has repeated live-refresh failures
gateway_repeated_refresh_failures.description: The Gateway is serving the last-known-good portfolio after at least three consecutive refresh failures. Review the Gateway attention reason and recommended action. The cached snapshot remains usable only while it is fresh.

gateway_snapshot_unavailable.title: Portfolio Gateway has no usable snapshot
gateway_snapshot_unavailable.description: The Gateway cannot provide a portfolio snapshot. Open the Portfolio Architect Gateway App, review its runtime status and logs, and restore live refreshes before using purchase recommendations.

gateway_refresh_overdue.title: Portfolio Gateway refresh is overdue
gateway_refresh_overdue.description: The next fixed-cadence refresh deadline passed beyond its grace period and no refresh is running. Review the Gateway App status and logs.

gateway_snapshot_integrity_failure.title: Portfolio Gateway snapshot integrity validation failed
gateway_snapshot_integrity_failure.description: Portfolio Architect rejected live data because its fingerprint, position count, timestamp, or health metadata was inconsistent. The previously accepted data remains protected. Review the Gateway and Home Assistant logs before continuing.
